ChatPanel.vue阶段6 UI优化4项代码修改已全部完成：
1. 收起侧边栏：sidebarCollapsed ref控制sidebar v-show，展开按钮chat-sidebar-expand
2. 输入框auto-resize：chatInputRef + autoResizeInput + Ctrl+Enter发送(handleInputKeydown)
3. 选中样式美化：border-left accent色 + font-weight:600 + transition
4. 创建聊天室内联输入框：creatingRoom/newRoomName ref + showCreateRoomInput/confirmCreateRoom/cancelCreateRoom
App.vue createChatRoom已适配接收name参数(不再用prompt)
样式修改：删除collapsed-bar→sidebar-expand样式；新增create-room-inline/input/actions样式；chat-input增强(border/border-radius/overflow-y/max-height/placeholder)
编译/构建和功能验证尚未执行
